top_choice_rationale: Gravity’s Rainbow and Mason & Dixon provide the firmest supplied basis for an oeuvre-level award: historical violence, science, power and countercultural imagination are rendered through unusually audacious linguistic and narrative forms. The later corpus remains insufficiently represented, but Pynchon’s demonstrated formal and intellectual enlargement of the novel is the strongest comparative achievement on this record.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile; it records professional ties to committee colleagues but no candidate-specific connection.
